alt.en: A large open laptop with teal trim showing code sits at the center of a gray floor. A dashed orange line carrying one packet runs to a pink-tinted sheet of log lines on the left. A teal tool tile with a terminal icon behind it and a pair of gray glasses on the right link to the laptop by dotted lines.
alt.zh: 灰色地面中央是一台打开的大笔记本电脑，带青绿色边饰，屏幕显示代码。一条载有数据包的橙色虚线通向左侧一张粉色日志纸。后方带终端图标的青绿色工具方块和右侧一副灰色眼镜，各以点线连到电脑。

caption.en: Illustration: a laptop stands for a workstation running the agentic review design Google describes, calling a tool, sending a report to the sheet on its left and examined by a reviewer, shown as glasses. It does not depict Sashiko, its review records or a tested deployment, and it does not show that the reviews work as described.
caption.zh: 示意图：笔记本电脑代表运行 Google 所描述的智能体代码审查流程的工作站，它调用工具，把审查报告送到左侧的纸页，右侧的眼镜代表检查代码的审查者。图中并非 Sashiko 本身、其审查记录或经过测试的部署，也不表明审查如所述般有效。
